purpose: Freeze the only character-level information permitted before confirmatory synthetic requalification: whether each aligned character is canonical A/C/G/T or noncanonical/missing. Nucleotide identity itself remains masked.

character_mask.all_other_characters: invalid/noncanonical including gap, N and IUPAC ambiguity codes
character_mask.storage: boolean valid/invalid mask only; nucleotide identity must not be persisted in phase-2 outputs
character_mask.sequence_line_handling: strip leading/trailing ASCII whitespace from each FASTA sequence line, then concatenate wrapped lines in file order

edge_admissibility.valid_sequence_pair: the two sequence masks have canonical-valid overlap in at least the minimum comparable columns
edge_admissibility.valid_frozen_edge: at least one sequence pair across its two frozen endpoint localities is valid
edge_admissibility.admissible_species: every frozen phase-1 edge is valid
edge_admissibility.failed_species: NOT_EVALUABLE_CHARACTER_SUPPORT; do not rewire edges and do not substitute another marker

survivor_panel.next_gate: repeat the full dataset-specific profiled-private Gate-D on the surviving response-blind geometry before nucleotide identities may be opened

forbidden: persisting A/C/G/T identities or any pairwise nucleotide differences
using divergence, TTF statistic, or empirical transfer outcome in species admissibility
changing the 50% comparable-site threshold after mask opening
switching loci for a species that fails the frozen edge-support rule
rewiring the frozen graph after character-mask opening
re-splitting or balancing train/evaluation species after character-mask opening
